verdict.rationale: Browserbase's docs state that browser agents can be deployed and run on Browserbase "on a schedule or on demand" [browserbase-docs-14], which directly covers automated, timed scraping runs. Continuous monitoring and price-tracking use cases [browserbase-docs-11, browserbase-docs-12] point the same way, and webhooks can report status changes from those runs [browserbase-docs-19]. The scheduling claim is a single one-line mention, though, so depth is thin. Missing for 10: documentation of how schedules are configured (cron syntax, time zones, specific-time triggers), schedule management via API or SDK, and independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled runs work.
